findings_resolved: Strictly reducing revocations use supplied shared ordinary 4096, global security 2048 and owner security 128 totals. Existing capability and live incarnation evidence are required at ordinary exhaustion; expired or absent-book credentials cannot spend reserve.
Repeated inactive or revoked operations do not spend capacity. Temporary target disablement cannot prevent permanent compromise revocation.
Early bounded admission retains ownership/highwater, canonical credential and original grant constraints; restored descriptors do not recreate ephemeral bearer authority.
integrator_review: Native authentication bytes remain exact; verified service actors have no fabricated ship.
Credential issuance returns raw bearer only once; persistent records retain hashes and original scoped shared grants. The outer Home carrier must enforce request idempotency before issuance.
Each effect rechecks current binding, catalog, issuer, exact original grants, scope, epoch, lease and current ephemeral incarnation. Restored descriptors alone cannot authorize.
Service grants and roster membership still need a real shared-core adapter; fixture grant rows are trusted test setup, not a live policy route.
limitations: Pure source and fixtures only; no hosted native execution of these 12 arms yet.
No new Home route, saved-state activation, service grant adapter or live agent execution is qualified.
